name: eufy Smart Lock E30 (US)

radios.note: CSA lists Thread and Bluetooth transports and notes built-in Wi-Fi. eufy's FAQ groups the T85F-series locks as Matter over Thread; Wi-Fi is used for the eufy app and remote control.

matter.note: CSA lists the eufy Smart Lock E30 from Anker Innovations (Matter 1.2, certified 2024-07-02, firmware V1.0.0.0, hardware V3). It is Matter over Thread, not over Wi-Fi.

apple_home.note: Matter over Thread. eufy says iOS 18 can add Matter devices without a hub and iPhone 15 Pro or later can control Thread devices directly, but remote control needs a HomePod mini, HomePod or Apple TV 4K as hub.

google_home.note: Matter over Thread; eufy's FAQ requires a Matter-capable Nest hub.

alexa.note: Matter over Thread; eufy's FAQ requires a Matter-enabled Echo device.

smartthings.note: eufy's product page lists SmartThings; its FAQ says a Matter-capable hub is required.

home_assistant.note: No Home Assistant docs page for this lock found. A community thread reports it works through the Matter integration, but forum posts are not enough on their own. Needs a Thread border router.

hubRequired.note: eufy markets it as needing no bridge, and the eufy app uses the lock's own Wi-Fi. Matter platforms need a Thread-capable hub, and Apple Home remote control needs a home hub.

localControl.note: No eufy source describes local-only control explicitly.

lockFit.note: Replaces a standard US deadbolt and keeps a physical keyhole for the mechanical key.

keypad.note: Keypad on the lock, plus a fingerprint reader.

power.note: eight AA batteries; eufy claims up to 8 months per set.

summary: eufy's Smart Lock E30 is a deadbolt replacement with a keypad and fingerprint reader that joins Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa and SmartThings over Matter on Thread. It also has built-in Wi-Fi for the eufy app. It takes eight AA batteries and keeps a keyhole for a spare key. Home Assistant support is unconfirmed by official docs.
caveats: Matter control needs a Thread border router or Matter hub: HomePod mini or Apple TV 4K, a Nest hub, an Echo, or a SmartThings hub.
Apple Home remote control needs a home hub even though iOS 18 can add the lock without one.
eufy says locks connected through HomeBase 3 cannot use Matter yet.
A Home Assistant forum thread reports early setup problems that a firmware update fixed.
